title: 第985章 抵达第984章 鎏金舟
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
上官灼华站起身，望着窗外昏暗肃杀的天地，沉声开口：“我们已经踏入东海境与云海郡的交界地域，前方百里之外，便是寒冥山脉地界。”
“寒冥山乃是一处极寒之地，整座山脉被万年不散的寒雾笼罩，阴气滔天、寒煞蚀骨，山中妖兽大多沾染煞气，凶性暴涨、性情暴戾。尤其是我们的目标冥风鸟，处于寒冥山中部及深处交界的地界，借助此地极阴寒气，它战力还会再增三分。”
“诸位稍后抵达寒冥山，切莫单独行动，以防被妖兽偷袭。”
众人纷纷颔首。
一路疾驰，片刻之后，一座连绵数千里、黑雾缭绕的苍茫山脉，终于遥遥出现在天际尽头。
那里阴风亘古不息，寒雾遮天蔽日，远远望去，死气沉沉、毫无生机，正是此行的目的地——寒冥山。
鎏金凤舟依旧全速破空，朝着前方苍茫山脉疾驰。
待飞舟前行五十来公里，官灼华忽然抬手结印，催动飞舟。
嗡——
鎏金凤周身灵光缓缓收敛，破空之势骤然停歇，稳稳悬停在一座孤峰之巅。
峰顶乱石嶙峋、草木稀疏，地势隐蔽，恰好可以隐匿身形、俯瞰四周。
“距离寒冥山只有五十公里了，我们就御空过去吧！”
上官灼华跳下飞舟，林潜四人几乎同时跳下。
紧接着上官灼华收起了飞舟。
随即她转头看向四人，沉声解释道：“寒冥山交界地带常有散修、野修出没，更有不少家族或者宗门的武者进入寒冥山搜寻阴属性灵药、猎杀妖兽。若是我们直接驾驶飞舟赶到寒冥山，太过瞩目，可能会引来旁人觊觎。”
“我等虽然不惧寻常武者挑衅，但此番首要任务是猎杀冥风鸟、没必要平白招惹是非、徒增变数。最后五十里路程，我们御空前往，即可。”
上官灼华的这一番话，说的有理有据，众人均是认同。
出门在外，从来不乏见利忘义之辈。
真器飞舟太过惹眼，在这无人管束的交界险地，极易勾起旁人杀人夺宝的贪欲。
多一事不如少一事，低调行事，方能最大程度保障任务顺利。

特别是林潜，觉得上官灼华处事谨慎，颇合他意。
在飞舟靠近寒冥山时，林潜就想开口提醒上官灼华的，但是想到若是他开口，不仅有喧宾夺主之嫌，更有可能引起其余三人不满，索性林潜就没有开口。
没想到，上官灼华自己主动开口了。
这也让林潜对那些大家族的弟子有了进一步的认识，并不是所有大家族的弟子都嚣张跋扈，不可一世，真正的精英弟子，不论是眼界还是头脑，都比那些散修强太多。
五人依次纵身跃下孤峰，落地之后，默契的将自身的气息收敛。
五人并未御空飞行，而是尽数踏地疾驰，贴在地面穿梭山林之间。
众人刻意压制身法速度，将速度压制在真丹境初期水准，不快不慢。
content_en:
Shangguan Zhuohua stood up, looked out the window at the dark and solemn world, and said in a deep voice: "We have entered the border area between the East China Sea and Yunhai County. A hundred miles ahead is the boundary of the Hanming Mountain Range."
"Hanming Mountain is an extremely cold place. The entire mountain range is shrouded in the cold mist that has lasted for thousands of years. The yin energy is overwhelming and the cold evil is eroding the bones. Most of the monsters in the mountain are contaminated with evil energy, and their ferocity has skyrocketed and their temperaments are violent. In particular, our target, the Hades Wind Bird, is located in the boundary between the middle and deep parts of Hanming Mountain. With the help of the extremely cold air here, its combat power will increase by another three points."
"Everyone will arrive at Hanming Mountain later. Please do not move alone to prevent being attacked by monsters."
Everyone nodded.
Speeding all the way, a moment later, a vast mountain range stretching for thousands of miles and shrouded in black mist finally appeared at the end of the sky.
The dark wind there is everlasting, and the cold fog covers the sky and the sun. From a distance, it looks lifeless and lifeless. It is the destination of this trip - Hanming Mountain.
The gilded phoenix boat still broke through the air at full speed, speeding towards the vast mountains ahead.
When the flying boat had traveled about fifty kilometers, Guan Zhuohua suddenly raised his hand to make a seal to activate the flying boat.
Buzz——
The aura around the gilded phoenix slowly converged, and its power to break through the air suddenly stopped, hovering steadily on the top of an isolated peak.
The top of the peak is rugged with rocks and sparse vegetation, and the terrain is secluded, making it perfect for hiding your body and overlooking the surroundings.
"We are only fifty kilometers away from Hanming Mountain, let's go there in the air!"
Shangguan Zhuohua jumped off the flying boat, and Lin Qian and four others jumped off almost at the same time.
Then Shangguan Zhuohua put away the flying boat.
Then she turned to look at the four people and explained in a deep voice: "There are often casual cultivators and wild cultivators in the border area of Hanming Mountain, and many warriors from families or sects enter Hanming Mountain to search for Yin attribute elixirs and hunt monsters. If we directly drive the flying boat to Hanming Mountain, it will attract too much attention and may attract others to covet us."
"Although we are not afraid of provocations from ordinary warriors, our first priority this time is to hunt the underworld birds. There is no need to cause trouble and increase variables. For the last fifty miles, we can travel by air."
What Shangguan Zhuohua said was reasonable and well-founded, and everyone agreed with it.
When you go out, there are always people who see benefits and forget their own righteousness.
The real flying boat is too eye-catching, and in this unruly and dangerous border area, it can easily arouse the greed of others to kill people and seize treasures.
It is better to do less than to do more, and to keep a low profile can ensure the success of the mission to the greatest extent.
Lin Qian, in particular, felt that Shangguan Zhuohua's cautious approach was quite to his liking.
When the flying boat approached Han Ming Mountain, Lin Qian wanted to speak to remind Shangguan Zhuohua, but thinking that if he spoke, he would not only be overshadowing the guest, but also more likely to cause dissatisfaction with the other three, so Lin Qian simply did not speak.
Unexpectedly, Shangguan Zhuohua took the initiative to speak.
This also gave Lin Qian a better understanding of the disciples of those big families. Not all disciples of big families were arrogant and arrogant. The real elite disciples were much better than those casual cultivators in terms of vision and brains.
The five people jumped off the lonely peak one after another. After landing, they tacitly controlled their auras.
The five of them did not fly in the air. Instead, they all stepped on the ground and galloped, sticking to the ground and traveling through the mountains and forests.
Everyone deliberately suppressed the speed of their body movements, keeping their speed at the level of the early stage of the true elixir realm, neither too fast nor too slow.
